test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 8 boys and 12 girls together can finish a project work in 5 days. If it takes 50 days for one boy alone to finish the same project, how many days are required for one girl alone to complete the same project work?
solution:
**Given:**

8 boys and 12 girls together can finish a project work in 5 days.

It takes 50 days for one boy alone to finish the same project.

**Formula Used:**

Work Rate of one boy = 1 / Days taken by one boy

Work Rate of one girl = 1 / Days taken by one girl

Combined Work Rate = Sum of individual work rates

Work Rate × Time = Total Work

**Calculation:**

Work Rate of one boy = 1 / 50

Let the number of days required for one girl alone to complete the project be x.

Work Rate of one girl = 1 / x

Combined Work Rate of 8 boys and 12 girls = 8 × (1/50) + 12 × (1/x)

Combined Work Rate of 8 boys and 12 girls = (8/50) + (12/x)

Total Work = 1 (since one complete project is considered as 1 unit of work)

Work Rate × Time = Total Work

[(8/50) + (12/x)] × 5 = 1

⇒ (8/50) + (12/x) = 1/5

⇒ 8/50 + 12/x = 1/5

⇒ 8x + 600 = 10x

⇒ 600 = 2x

⇒ x = 600 /2

⇒ x = 300

**One girl alone can complete the project in 300 days.**
